lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 4-5 visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-regular rectangular grid on the lateral mid-section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance spots, creating anchor points at roughly 90-degree intersections along the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, showing a distinct light-to-shadow vertical gradient from top to bottom.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of smaller, less-defined high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
